The '''A4 Juggernaut''' was a [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]-old war vehicle used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
By the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] rise, this wheeled vehicle was no longer considered top-of-the-line military equipment and had long since been replaced by the [[HAVw A5 Juggernaut|A5]] and [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|A6]] models.

The brilliant weapons/[[Droid/Legends|droid]] engineer [[Min Erethen]] used a modified A4 named the ''[[Sanctum Sanctorum]]'' as a base-of-operations aboard the guardian [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[Bhishana Bhaga]]'' while working for [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]].
